ios.desc:
Acorn: the Ultimate Book Summary and Podcast App
Acorn brings the world’s best ideas to your fingertips with bite-sized podcasts, audio summaries, and expertly curated book lists. Discover insights that inspire and inform across topics like technology, history, arts, health, aging and more —all while relaxing or on the go.

Your Pocket-Sized Guide to Big Ideas!

500+ Must-Listen Podcasts & Book Summaries: Explore hand-picked book lists by theme, mood, or trending topics, making it easy to find what resonates with you.
AI Deepdive - Talk to Books: Go beyond summaries with our personalized AI Deepdive. Engage with complex concepts in real time using an integrated voice assistant that answers your questions and sparks dynamic learning.
Fuel Your Curiosity: From history classics to modern negotiation techniques, Acorn transforms every learning session into an inspiring, interactive conversation. Grow your knowledge and discover new perspectives—anytime, anywhere.

Acorn is your ultimate companion for smarter, simpler learning. Unlock the big ideas behind every great book, master key concepts, and draw inspiration from the lives of remarkable thinkers. Transform the way you learn—download Acorn today and experience the power of on-the-go knowledge!
Download Acorn today to make micro-learning easier on the go!
Privacy: https://acornx.ai/privacy
Terms Of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

quotes.text:
Hey HN!

We’re a small Bay Area–based team of book lovers building Acorn, an app that helps you digest books via conversational learning and real-time interaction with the content. We currently offer 500+ book podcasts and summaries across self-improvement, health, tech, business, and more.

For each book, we curate audio summaries and podcasts with AI-driven Q&A so you can “chat” directly with the book - We call it AI Deepdive — just ask a question at any point, and you’ll get insights tailored to your curiosity.

Acorn just officially launched a few days ago! Check it out at: 
IOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6737609162?pt=127309359&ct=hn&mt=8
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.acornx.acorn.discover

Feel free to give it a try and let us know your thoughts and feedback!

Thank you!
